summary: Puma home kit, launched 18 Jul 2026 ('One Crest, One Glory'). Front: NHC main, flynas upper chest, Reef centre chest; sleeve: tree (Tree Digital Insurance); upper back: Riyad Bank (renewed Aug 2026). Shorts carry only crest and Puma marks; every placement checked against the club's official store product photos, the league kit gallery and club announcements.
